description: This file defines the 'Customer' class within the OpenCart admin model extension report namespace. It contains methods to generate various reports related to customers, including total counts by day, week, month, and year, as well as detailed customer and order data. The report class interacts with the database to fetch and aggregate customer-related statistics.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents customer-related report functionalities in the admin area, including statistics by day, week, month, year, detailed customer info, and order data.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts split by each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts grouped by the day of the week for the past week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts grouped by each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts grouped by month for the current year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on filtering parameters such as date range, group, customer name, order status, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers based on optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders with optional filtering by date range.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves detailed order information including customer info, order status, total, and product count, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Fetches reward points information for customers, including points total, number of orders, and total spent, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns the total count of customers with reward points, considering filters.

methods.name: getCustomerActivities
methods.description: Retrieves customer activity logs including actions taken, IP addresses, and timestamps, with filtering.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerActivities
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer activities with filtering capabilities.

methods.name: getCustomerSearches
methods.description: Fetches recorded customer search keywords and related info, with filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerSearches
methods.description: Returns total number of customer search records, with filtering options.
